milestone: M56 Arbitrary Repository Coding Golden Journey

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: A headless continuation can consume the M56.2 objective proposal candidate route by authorizing that exact candidate once, refreshing latest preflight/apply-plan evidence, and routing to explicit apply without caller-side proposal sequencing.
The phase uses existing proposal approval and preflight/apply-plan machinery for one validated replace_file candidate, but still performs no workspace apply mutation.

The continuation result and checkpoint provide a replay-safe agent-loop transition from proposal candidate review to explicit apply routing without exposing raw data or requiring caller-side sequencing.
Rust validates journey/session/drive/task/run/proposal/source-event identities, objective/context fingerprints, candidate fingerprint, status labels, and route state before any approval side effect.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with direct support from controlled_workspace_tools, persistent_structured_ledger, context_management, and runtime_permission_enforcement.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can now consume an objective_proposal_candidate route, approve that exact valid pending replace_file proposal once, refresh latest preflight/apply-plan evidence, persist a bounded authorization/preflight checkpoint, and route to explicit apply.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Generic proposal.approve and proposal.preflight are not bound to the M56.2 candidate fingerprint, journey checkpoint, source drive route, objective/context fingerprints, or duplicate-free continuation replay identity.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: The Golden Journey remains stuck after proposal candidate review and requires caller-side proposal approval/preflight sequencing before any controlled apply route can be trusted.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M56.2 candidate binding, M56.1 objective/context admission, and M55.1 journey admission atomicity because it crosses the next non-mutating authorization/preflight boundary for the already selected candidate.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase extends existing headless.continue_once params/results and route kinds; it adds no new JSON-RPC method.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It returns one bounded continuation result and checkpoint for the route; it adds no report, readiness, history, digest, verdict, inspection, preview, dashboard, or summary endpoint.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Rust now verifies the current objective proposal route, approves only the exact candidate, runs the latest preflight/apply-plan boundary, writes replay-safe checkpoint evidence, rejects stale or mismatched evidence before side effects, and replays without duplicate approval/preflight events.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A scheduled controller can deterministically move from runtime-selected proposal candidate review to an explicit apply-ready route without parsing raw ledgers or coordinating separate proposal.approve/proposal.preflight calls itself.
answers.milestone_progress: Moves M56 from reviewable objective proposal candidate to authorized and preflighted proposal evidence, enabling the later explicit apply, verification, recovery, and accepted-completion phases.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts a bounded objective_proposal_authorization_preflight_target for the current review_and_authorize_objective_proposal route

Rust validates journey/session/drive ids, source task/run/proposal/source-event ids, expected operation/status labels, journey/objective/selected-context/path/candidate fingerprints, and source drive route before approval
A valid pending replace_file candidate is approved once using existing proposal approval machinery and records bounded approval evidence
The route creates or refreshes latest preflight snapshot/apply-plan evidence for the same proposal and requires apply_plan.status = Ready
The response includes bounded objective_proposal_authorization_preflight_result and next_route.kind = apply_authorized_objective_proposal_explicitly
Exact replay returns the same authorization/preflight fingerprint without duplicate approval, preflight, apply-plan, or checkpoint events
Mismatch, stale, wrong-route, rejected, invalid, ambiguous, malformed, non-pending, or conflicting evidence fails before new approval/preflight side effects
No workspace file is applied or mutated, and no new JSON-RPC method or wrapper/report/readiness/history/digest/inspection surface is added

RPC, checkpoint, and ledger-facing payloads exclude raw prompts, provider responses, file content, proposed content, hunks, diffs, stdout/stderr, commands, environment, raw requests, raw ledger payloads, absolute paths, canonical paths, secrets, and raw authorization tokens
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test headless_continue_authorizes_and_preflights_objective_proposal_candidate_once covers successful route consumption, approval, latest preflight/apply-plan evidence, explicit apply route, no workspace mutation, bounded payload, checkpointing, and duplicate-free replay
Rust behavior test headless_continue_objective_authorization_preflight_denies_mismatch_before_side_effects covers mismatch denial before approval/preflight side effects
Existing M56.2 objective proposal candidate tests continue to cover candidate derivation, ambiguity denial, and duplicate-free source drive replay
VSIX protocol tests accept bounded objective authorization/preflight params and results and reject malformed or raw-data-bearing payloads

accepted_capability: Runtime-owned objective proposal authorization and latest preflight route
safety_boundary: uses existing proposal approval and preflight/apply-plan gates
validates candidate identity and route state before approval side effects
does not apply or mutate workspace files
persists only bounded ids, statuses, counts, timestamps, and SHA-256 fingerprints
non_goals: no file apply or workspace mutation
no shell, git, network, provider, service, verifier, scheduler, or daemon expansion

persisting raw authorization token, proposal content, file content, or diffs in continuation metadata
technical_debt: The apply step remains explicit and must be implemented by a later M56 phase against the authorization/preflight checkpoint.
Runtime lib.rs remains large and should be split only by a later behavior-preserving MOVE-only refactor.
next_capability_rationale: M56.4 should consume the authorized/preflighted objective proposal route with a controlled apply execution boundary, preserving one-time authorization and replay invariants.
